prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” marketing agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and preferred working style. To help quickly:

Quick suggestions (Kansas City agencies with strong reputations)
- VML / VMLY&R — global, full-service capability; good for large national/international brand work and integrated campaigns.
- Barkley — large independent creative agency based in KC; strong brand and creative work.
(Those two are commonly recommended for big, brand-driven work out of Kansas City. There are also many excellent small-to-mid agencies focused on digital performance, B2B, SEO/SEM, social, and web dev.)

How to pick the “best” for you
- Define goals: brand-building, lead generation, e‑commerce growth, SEO, paid media, etc.
- Budget and timeline: agencies specialize in different engagement sizes.
- Industry experience: look for case studies in your sector.
- KPIs and reporting: how will success be measured and reported?
- Team fit and communication style: who will actually do the work?
- References and results: ask for client references and measurable outcomes.

If you want, tell me:
- Your main goals (brand awareness, leads, sales, website, social, etc.)
- Monthly/annual budget range
- B2B or B2C and your industry
- Timeline and geography (local/regional/national)

I’ll recommend a short list of Kansas City agencies matched to your needs and what to ask them in an RFP.
